title: Put the environment name in the log line of the shipped page job
mr_title: Draft: Name the environment in the shipped job's log line
mr_description:
Closes https://gitlab.com/gitlab-ai-hackathon/transcend-october-2026/39194174/showcase/-/work_items/45

## What changed
- `itemator/shipped.py`: the final log line is now `itemator shipped: <environment>: N deployments, ...` (for example `itemator shipped: production: 3 deployments, ...`). It uses the same cleaned environment name that the page and `shipped.json` already carry.
- `tests/test_shipped.py`: one new test, `test_the_log_line_says_which_environment_it_read`, runs `main` with `--environment staging` and checks the wording.

## Verification
- `pytest` could not be installed in this environment (the package proxy returned 403), so `python -m pytest` was **not run**.
- Fallback: I ran every test in `tests/test_shipped.py` (11, including the new one) with a small hand-written runner under Python 3.12. All passed. The rest of the suite was not run, so CI is the real check for it.

## Beyond the issue
Nothing.

card.final_line: No one but the author described this change.
